messages:
liz_sales: Quick Q from buyer: Private deploy into their transit VPC. Must keep original client src IP for audit and they do TLS-inspect in DMZ. Also want a small cost comparison: static EIP per-AZ vs shared NAT. Need a one-pager + checklist they can hand to NetOps.

omar_se: Short: yes we can. Preserving src IP depends on where SNAT occurs. If traffic goes through a TGW NAT you'll see the NAT IP. Options: 1) PrivateLink ENIs (avoid SNAT), 2) internal NLB + static EIP mapping on our side, 3) DMZ proxy that forwards PROXY/X-Forwarded-For, 4) 1:1 SNAT (EIP per host).

nijah_netops: Clarifying: how will on-prem attach? Direct Connect -> TGW hairpin is common and will NAT. If they can route service traffic via PrivateLink ENIs we avoid NAT. MTU: with IPsec/encap recommend PMTU ~1400. Keepalive <60s for streaming.

sana_sec: TLS-inspect note: permitted if customer retains keys and we terminate mTLS at connector inside their VPC. We support mTLS and customer-managed KMS. I'll draft the security blurb (min TLS1.2, preferred TLS1.3, ciphers, KMS/audit).

omar_se: Pasteable firewall snippet (give to NetOps):

```
# Outbound egress recommendations
Allow TCP 443 -> *.redwood-private.<region>.svc  # prefer FQDN allowlist
Allow UDP 123 -> 0.0.0.0/0                      # NTP
# Optional inbound health probes
Allow TCP 443 <- <redwood-health-ips>
```

Also: we publish IP ranges in onboarding JSON. FQDN allowlist reduces churn.

nijah_netops: Src-IP options quick: NLB+EIP = consistent external src, PROXY header preserves true client IP (app must support), 1:1 SNAT = costly. If TGW NAT sits in path you lose original. ALB needs proxy protocol to preserve.

liz_sales: Buyer asked: "how much more for per-AZ static EIPs vs NAT?" Any ballpark?

omar_se: Ballpark: managed per-EIP add-on typically billed monthly per-EIP (order-of-magnitude: tens-to-low-hundreds USD/EIP/month depending on region/contract) + egress. Shared NAT is cheaper infra but can't guarantee sticky per-customer src IP on failover. I'll confirm exact numbers with finance.

onboard-bot: Onboarding checklist updated: https://redwood.internal/onboard/edge-onramp/connectivity

sana_sec: I'll attach SQ text and a short paragraph on TLS inspect + mTLS termination.

omar_se: Action items: Omar -> one-pager decision matrix (PrivateLink vs TGW vs peering) with src-IP tradeoffs & diagram. Nijah -> DMZ proxy + PROXY protocol example and MTU/keepalive ops note. Sana -> security text. Liz -> confirm with buyer whether PROXY headers acceptable or they need per-EIP.

liz_sales: I'll get that answer in tomorrow's sync and share the one-pager. Thanks all :thumbsup:
